reason: The two methods are functionally equivalent for all deterministic, bounded inputs. Both compare the year and the day-of-year (via Calendar) or the year, month, and day-of-month (via Date's deprecated getters). For any pair of Date objects, the conditions for returning true coincide, and both return false otherwise. No concrete input can be constructed that causes one method to return true while the other returns false, nor can one method terminate while the other does not. Therefore, no separating test case exists.
